blocks.zh: 重點提示 使用說明 How to Use This Reference List
blocks.en: Key Point: How to Use This Reference List

blocks.zh: 本節完整重現 TR33 原文第 8.0 章之全部 110 筆參考文獻，供讀者查證原始出處。內容涵蓋：(1) 各國藥典通則 (USP、Ph. Eur.、JP、ChP、IP、BP) 對於 Alternative Microbiological Methods (AMM) / Rapid Microbiological Methods (RMM) 確效之通則規定；(2) ICH Q2(R2)、Q9(R1) 等分析方法確效與品質風險管理指引；(3) FDA、EMA、歐盟執委會之法規指引與變更管理程序；(4) PDA 技術報告系列（TR44、TR50 等）；(5) 支持 RMM 技術原理（流式細胞、螢光顯微、核酸擴增、AI/ML 影像辨識等）之期刊文獻。此清單為 Amaran Biotechnology 取得授權之內部參考資料，僅供內部教育訓練使用，不得對外散布。
blocks.en: This section reproduces in full all 110 references from Section 8.0 of the original TR33 text so that readers can verify the original sources. The list covers: (1) pharmacopoeial general chapters (USP, Ph. Eur., JP, ChP, IP, BP) on the validation of Alternative Microbiological Methods (AMM) / Rapid Microbiological Methods (RMM); (2) analytical method validation and quality risk management guidelines such as ICH Q2(R2) and Q9(R1); (3) regulatory guidance and change management procedures from the FDA, EMA, and European Commission; (4) the PDA Technical Report series (TR44, TR50, etc.); and (5) journal literature supporting the technical principles of RMM (flow cytometry, fluorescence microscopy, nucleic acid amplification, AI/ML image recognition, etc.). This list is internal reference material used under license by Amaran Biotechnology and is intended for internal training only; it must not be distributed externally.
